name: comp-467

frames.best_why: Full table visible with one row lifted by a lighter hover background under the cursor.

tagline: Dark table rows pairing round profile photos with names, emails and balances.
summary: A four-row account table whose first column holds a circular photo next to a name and handle, followed by email, location, status and a right-aligned balance.
appearance: On near-black, a five-column table with small grey uppercase headers runs edge to edge. Each name cell starts with a round 40px photo, then a bold name over a faint handle; the balance column sits right-aligned. A small grey caption sits under the table.
behaviour: Almost still: as the pointer travels down the rows, whichever row it is over picks up a faint lighter background and the rest stay dark.
demo_content: Four people with emails, cities and balances, captioned "Table with images".
search_phrases: table with profile pictures in first column
user list with avatar and email
dark data table of team members
accounts table with status and balance
customer rows with round photo thumbnails
table of names handles and locations
list showing who owes what balance
use_when: A user or team directory needs a photo beside each name inside an ordinary data table.
avoid_when: The four rows and their remote avatar links are written in the file, so any real data means editing the source.
customise: People, columns and the caption live in an items array inside the file; changing them is a source edit. Row and header styling comes from the shared table primitives.
weight_why: Four plain table rows and four remote images; no animation code runs.

a11y.note: Avatars carry the person's name as alt text and headers are real table header cells; there is nothing interactive to focus.

issues: Avatar photos are fetched from GitHub raw URLs, so they stay blank when offline.
The caption "Table with images" is filler text rather than real content.
polish_why: Tidy spacing and crisp avatars, but plain default table styling and a placeholder caption.
title: Table With Avatars
